name: cybara
description: Open-source multi-agent AI platform with CLI, web, desktop, and mobile apps, broad provider and channel support, MCP host/client, media generation, and multi-agent orchestration.

scripts.dev: bun run build && cd ui && bun run build && cd .. && bun run --watch src/index.ts
scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --external electron --external @aws-sdk/client-s3 --external tiny-secp256k1 --external kokoro-js --external @huggingface/transformers
scripts.build:cli: bun build src/cli/index.tsx --outdir dist --entry-naming cli.js --target bun --external electron --external @aws-sdk/client-s3 --external tiny-secp256k1
scripts.build:main: bun build src/main.ts --outdir dist --target bun --external electron --external @aws-sdk/client-s3 --external tiny-secp256k1
scripts.build:all: bun run ui:build && bun run build && bun run build:cli && bun run build:main
scripts.start:prod: bun run build:all && bun run start
scripts.benchmark:gateway: bun run build && bun run scripts/benchmark-gateway.ts
scripts.audit:ci: bun run audit:root && bun run audit:ui && bun run audit:mobile && bun run audit:site
scripts.check:ci: bun run typecheck && bun run ui:typecheck && bun run lint && bun run ui:lint && bun run format:check && bun run check:loc && bun run mobile:expo-check && bun run mobile:typecheck && bun run doctor && bun run test:smoke && bun run deadcode
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check
scripts.test:smoke:full: bun run test:core && bun run test:isolated tests/runtime && bun run test:isolated tests/api/security.test.ts tests/api/browser-routes-mocked.test.ts tests/api/channel-security-routes-mocked.test.ts && bun run test:isolated tests/e2e
scripts.test: bun run test:isolated tests/core tests/api tests/channels tests/cli tests/runtime tests/mobile tests/ui
scripts.sexy: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check
scripts.sexy:write: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format
scripts.tauri:dev: bun run tauri:dev:prep && bun run tauri:sidecar && bunx tauri dev
scripts.tauri:dev:prep: bun run scripts/prepare-tauri-dev.ts && bun run package
scripts.tauri:build: bun run tauri:sidecar && bunx tauri build
scripts.tauri:build:release: bun run tauri:sidecar && bun run tauri:prepare-release && bunx tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.release.conf.json
scripts.native:macos:run: bun run ui:build && bun run tauri:sidecar && swift run --package-path apps/macos/Cybara

author: Carsen Klock @metaspartan
